data.mermaid:
erDiagram
  PATIENT ||--o{ VISIT : "has"
  DOCTOR ||--o{ VISIT : "attends"
  BED ||--o{ VISIT : "assigned"
  VISIT ||--o{ PRESCRIPTION : "contains"
  MEDICINE ||--o{ PRESCRIPTION : "in"
  VISIT ||--|| BILL : "generates"
  PATIENT {
    int patient_id PK
    string patient_name
    string gender
    date date_of_birth
    string phone UK
    string address
    string blood_group
    string emergency_contact
    date registration_date
  }
  DOCTOR {
    int doctor_id PK
    string doctor_name
    string department
    string specialization
    string phone UK
    decimal consultation_fee
    string shift
    string availability_status
  }
  BED {
    int bed_id PK
    string ward_type
    string bed_status
    decimal daily_charge
  }
  MEDICINE {
    int medicine_id PK
    string medicine_name
    string manufacturer
    decimal price_per_unit
    int stock_quantity
  }
  VISIT {
    int visit_id PK
    int patient_id FK
    int doctor_id FK
    int bed_id FK
    string visit_type
    datetime visit_datetime
    string complaint
    int triage_level
    string visit_status
    datetime admit_time
    datetime discharge_time
  }
  PRESCRIPTION {
    int prescription_id PK
    int visit_id FK
    int medicine_id FK
    string dosage
    int duration_days
    int quantity
  }
  BILL {
    int bill_id PK
    int visit_id FK UK
    decimal consultation_charge
    decimal medicine_charge
    decimal bed_charge
    decimal total_amount
    string payment_mode
    string payment_status
    date bill_date
  }
  AUDIT_LOG {
    int log_id PK
    string table_name
    string action_type
    int record_id
    string changed_by
    datetime change_time
    string description
  }
